item.title: Charlotte man sentenced to nearly 22 years in prison after pleading guilty to meth trafficking
item.description: A federal investigation resulted in the seizure of large quantities of methamphetamine, fentanyl, two firearms, large sums of cash, and a stolen vehicle.

item.title: West Charlotte house fire causes $70,000 in damages, displaces family
item.description: No additional civilian injuries were reported, and no firefighters were injured during the incident.

item.title: Firefighters rescue van occupant who suffers life-threatening injuries in northwest Charlotte crash
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- A van crashing in northwest Charlotte Wednesday evening resulted in serious injuries. According to the Long Creek Fire Department, firefighters responded to a crash at 6:50 p.m. with a pinned occupant in the 5900 block of Mount Holly-Huntersville Road in the Mountain Island area. Long Creek’s Engine 10 was able to extricate the occupant after 30 minutes. [...]

item.title: CMS, other Charlotte-area schools remain closed or delayed Thursday
item.description: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools will operate on a two-hour delay on Thursday, Jan. 29, due to weather conditions, district officials announced.

item.title: Suspect arrested in Texas in killing of Charlotte DoorDash driver: CMPD
item.description: DoorDash has confirmed that the man killed in a shooting Sunday night in west Charlotte was one of its delivery drivers.

item.title: SC Gov. McMaster touts economy, warns about infrastructure amid rapid population growth in final State of the State
item.description: McMaster says $9.1 billion was invested into the state’s economy last year, creating thousands of jobs.

item.title: Outgoing NC Sen. Thom Tillis says DHS Secretary Kristi Noem has 'failed,' wants someone else with law enforcement background
item.description: Senator Thom Tillis has called for the resignation of Department of Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem following the death of Alex Pretti in Minneapolis, citing her lack of law enforcement training.

item.title: Fire marshal determined Matthews fire allegedly set by fire department leader was 'suspicious'
item.description: Firefighters responded Jan. 12 to a structure fire of the former Boston Market in the 9500 block of East Independence.

item.title: 'This isn't a childhood rash': North Carolina sees measles spike, officials push vaccines
item.description: Health officials North Carolina have reported 14 cases of measles since December, with three cases in the last week, and are urging people to get vaccinated to avoid potential complications and quarantine.

item.title: Dangerous cold, possible snow likely to hit the region this weekend
item.description: A Cold Weather Advisory is in effect for the mountains with wind chills as low as 10 degrees below zero, and a snowstorm is expected to hit the area this weekend, bringing light, fluffy snow and dangerous cold with it.
